questions.text: How warm is the air around the village rather than the sunlit ground?
How much moisture is in this air mass?
Which way and how fast is the air moving above the trees?
Is the approaching boundary separating warmer and colder air?
Did the front passing the village change its temperature?
Is rising air forming cloud droplets or only moving existing cloud?
Which air mass lies on each side of this front?
How much rain reached the ground during this storm?
Could air above the surface move differently from air near the ground?
Which vertical layer contains most of this weather?
Does a dry air mass mean there is no water vapor at all?
Can a surface pressure reading alone tell us where smoke will go?
Has a wind shift occurred since the last observation?
Does a front symbol on the map constitute a physical wall?
If humidity is unmeasured should we treat the air as dry?
